name: Gadhvi Hidden Falls
address: Deep forest path, Ahwa, Dang, Gujarat
shortDescription: Untouched perennial waterfall deep in the Dang forest.
description: Gadhvi Hidden Falls is a scenic natural cascade nestled inside the dense teak forests of Dang. Accessible via a 2km trek through tribal hamlets, it features crystal clear pools and lush monsoon flora.
travelTips: Wear trekking shoes
Carry drinking water

name: Polo Forest Ancient Ruins
shortDescription: 15th-century Jain and Shiva temples amidst dense dry deciduous forest.
description: The ancient Polo forest is spread over 400 square kilometers near Vijayanagar. It was established around the 10th century by the Parihar kings of Idar and subsequently conquered by the Rathod Rajputs. The site features ruins of intricately carved 15th century Jain and Shiva shrines along the Harnav River.
travelTips: Nearest railway station is Himmatnagar (60km)
